From hype to help: the Frontier journey for PHR leaders

Frontier Firms aren't the ones running the most AI pilots. They redesign work so that people set the direction and agents take on more of the execution.

What you hear vs. what the data says

Flip the switch to replace each claim with the evidence.

“AI will replace our people.”
86%of AI users treat AI output as a starting point, not an answer — people stay responsible for the thinking.
Flip to Help →
“Buy the licences and the value will follow.”
2×Culture, manager support and talent practices drive more than twice the AI impact of individual effort (67% vs. 32%).
Flip to Help →
“AI is an IT project.”
+17 ptsin recognised AI value when managers actively model AI use. Yet only 1 in 4 workers see clear leadership alignment on AI.
Flip to Help →
Journey to the Frontier FirmNot a straight line — most organisations work in all three phases at once.
Phase 1

Human with assistant

Every employee has an AI assistant that helps them work better and faster.

At PHR · a VP prepares Monday's management meeting from mail, Teams and files in minutes, not hours.
CopilotWork IQ
Phase 2

Human-agent teams

Agents join teams as digital colleagues, taking on specific tasks at human direction.

At PHR · Researcher builds a cited benchmark, Analyst works through the production workbooks and Cowork assembles the weekly review pack.
CoworkResearcherAnalystCustom agents
Phase 3

Human-led, agent-operated

People set the direction; agents run whole processes and workflows, checking in as needed.

At PHR · an always-on Autopilot keeps the Field B recovery plan moving — following up, flagging risks and asking before anything consequential.
AutopilotRolling out to Frontier
Your role in this room
1 · Model itUse Copilot on your own week, and let your team see you do it.
2 · Align itAgree two or three priority workflows per function, and say it the same way.
3 · Redesign one workflowPick one recurring report and hand it to an agent or to Cowork.
Sources · 2026 Work Trend Index: Agents, human agency and the opportunity for every organization and Key takeaways · 2025 Work Trend Index: The year the Frontier Firm is born — Microsoft WorkLab · What's New in Microsoft Copilot, October 2026 — Microsoft Tech Community

AI user profiles: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced

Each step up adds capability and cost. Place people by the work they actually do with AI — not by their title.

For leaders
  • Start everyone at Basic.
  • License Intermediate by use case.
  • Fund Advanced by the outcome it delivers.
1
Level 1

Basic

Copilot Chat (Basic)

Who: new or occasional AI users — the starting point for every PHR employee on an eligible Microsoft 365 plan.

  • Rewrite a memo or safety bulletin
  • Summarize an uploaded SOP
  • Web research on a technical topic, with sources
  • Approved agents from the store
Move up when they use AI on most working days and have a use case that needs their own work data.
2
Level 2

Intermediate

Microsoft Copilot (Premium) · USL

Who: leaders and knowledge workers whose work lives in email, meetings, Teams and Office files.

  • Prepare a management meeting with Work IQ
  • Teams meeting recap, inbox catch-up and drafted replies
  • Production-report analysis with Analyst; deep research with Researcher
  • Custom agents in Agent Builder on the team's own knowledge
Move up when they have repeatable multi-step work with a measurable time saving.
3
Level 3

Advanced

USL+ Copilot Credits · Cowork

Who: people who hand off whole outcomes rather than single prompts.

  • Weekly production & workover review delegated to Cowork
  • Recurring report packs that run on a schedule
  • Preparation packs for management meetings
  • A dashboard, a Word summary and a draft email from one brief
Needs a Copilot Credits spending policy that selects Cowork — the policy is an access control, not just a budget.
IncludedEligible Microsoft 365 subscription · no add-on
Fixed per user per monthMicrosoft Copilot license (USL)
USL + Copilot Credits per taskUsage-based billing (UBB)
Sources · Get started with Microsoft Copilot Chat — Microsoft Support · USL and usage-based billing · Agent Builder · Use Copilot Cowork — Microsoft Learn

Prompting like a pro — build a prompt from four ingredients

A prompt is how you ask Copilot to create, summarize, edit, transform or catch you up — in plain language, with enough context to do the job well.

The strongest prompts include four things — Goal, Context, Source and Expectations. Click a card to add its part to the prompt; click it again to take it out.

Work IQ on/off — web-grounded vs. Work IQ–grounded chat

There's one chat box with a single Work IQ toggle — flip it to control what Copilot grounds its answer in. The example prompts are written for PHR work, in Bahasa Indonesia.

Copilot
ChatCowork
Message Copilot
+Auto ▾↑
Flip the Work IQ switchOne chat, one toggle — not two separate chats.
Work IQ off Copilot Chat (Basic)Premium

Web-grounded chat

Copilot answers from the web and the model's training data, plus the files you hand it — none of your Microsoft 365 data. Every prompt starts with you finding, attaching or pasting the material first.

  • Open-web knowledge
  • Plus any files you attach — and, in Outlook and Teams, the content you have open
  • Available to Basic & Premium
Work IQ on Microsoft Copilot (Premium)

Work IQ–grounded chat

On by default. Copilot also reasons over your work across Microsoft 365 — emails, chats, meetings and files — trimmed to what you already have permission to see. The context is there before you type.

  • Everything web-grounded chat does
  • Your emails, chats, meetings and files
  • Permission-trimmed — nothing you can't already open
Grounded inWeb (Bing)Files you attachOpen email / Teams content
Grounded inWeb (Bing)Files you attachMail & calendarTeams chats & meetingsSharePoint & OneDrive
Example prompts for PHR · Bahasa IndonesiaWork IQ offWork IQ on
Tanpa Work IQ ·HSSE · Well Service
Ringkas /SOP Permit to Work Rev.3.pdf menjadi 10 poin untuk safety briefing pagi kru well service, dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami pekerja lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Production Engineer
Bandingkan /Laporan Produksi Harian 8 Nov.xlsx dengan /Laporan Produksi Harian 9 Nov.xlsx. Tampilkan 5 sumur dengan penurunan terbesar dan pertanyaan yang perlu saya ajukan ke tim lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Facility Engineer · web
Cari praktik terbaik global untuk mengurangi heat loss pada jaringan pipa injeksi uap di lapangan steamflood. Sertakan sumber dan buat ringkasan satu halaman.
Dengan Work IQ ·Production Superintendent
Siapkan bahan morning meeting saya besok: agenda dari undangan kalender, isu produksi dan HSSE yang dibahas di Teams hari ini, dan email penting yang belum saya balas.
Dengan Work IQ ·Workover Planner
Rangkum perkembangan program workover minggu ini dari email, chat Teams, dan notulen rapat — keputusan apa yang sudah diambil, siapa PIC-nya, dan apa yang masih tertunda?
Dengan Work IQ ·SCM · Contract Owner
Dari rapat dan email dengan [vendor jasa rig] bulan ini, apa saja tindak lanjut yang saya janjikan dan mana yang belum selesai?

Notice the pattern. Each prompt starts with you supplying the material — attaching a file with /, or asking the web. Copilot is capable, but it starts from zero every time.

The prompt gets shorter, and the question gets bigger. You stop describing the material and ask about your actual work — your meetings, mail, chats and files are already in context.

Work IQ is part of Microsoft IQ — the intelligence platform that also brings Fabric IQ (Power BI and Fabric data), Foundry IQ and Web IQ. For PHR, Fabric data in Microsoft Copilot is the path to Power BI production reports.

Buatkan dasbor pimpinan mingguan saya dalam satu file HTML interaktif, agar saya bisa memahami kondisi minggu ini dalam 5 menit. Copilot in the Teams meeting — catch up and raise what's still open

Joined late? Ask Copilot what has been discussed so far — then pull the history of the same topic from earlier meetings, so you raise what is still open.

Copilot in Teams Premium Work IQ

Ask about the meeting while it is still running — Copilot answers privately from the live transcript and chat. For what was agreed in earlier meetings, Copilot Chat with Work IQ reads past notes, files and email.

Four prompts to try this week — and where to run each one

Microsoft Copilot (Premium)Four everyday jobs, four places to run them. Each prompt is one or two sentences in Bahasa Indonesia — the app you open decides what Copilot works on.

01 · Copilot Chat · Work IQ

Prepare for tomorrow's meeting

Run it inMicrosoft Copilot app → ChatAlso in Teams, and at copilot.cloud.microsoft
Prompt

Saya akan rapat dengan /[nama] besok. Dari email, chat, dan rapat 30 hari terakhir, ringkas isu yang masih terbuka, janji saya kepadanya, dan 3 pertanyaan yang sebaiknya saya ajukan.

You get

A one-page brief: open issues, what you promised, and three questions — each with its source.

Tip

Type / and pick the person from the list.

02 · Word

A one-page summary of a long report

Run it inWord → open the report → CopilotCopilot button on the Home tab
Prompt

Tambahkan ringkasan eksekutif satu halaman di awal dokumen ini untuk Direksi: latar belakang, 3 temuan utama, risiko, dan keputusan yang diminta.

You get

A summary page at the top of the report, in Word styles you can edit — the rest stays as it is.

Tip

Check the figures against the report before you forward it.

03 · Excel

What the production numbers say

Run it inExcel → open the workbook → CopilotCopilot button on the Home tab
Prompt

Bandingkan produksi aktual dan target per lapangan, tandai yang deviasinya lebih dari 5%, lalu buat grafik tren mingguan dan tulis 3 temuan utama di sheet baru.

You get

Deviations highlighted, a weekly trend chart, and three findings on a new sheet.

Tip

Save the workbook in OneDrive or SharePoint, with the data in a table with clear headers.

04 · PowerPoint

A town hall deck from a report

Run it inPowerPoint → new presentation → CopilotStart from the PHR template
Prompt

Buat presentasi 6 slide untuk town hall dari /[laporan kinerja Q3]: capaian, tantangan, prioritas Q4, dan pesan pimpinan, lengkap dengan catatan pembicara.

You get

A six-slide draft with speaker notes, in your template, ready for your edits.

Tip

Type / to pick the report from OneDrive or SharePoint.

How to run any of them
1 · CopyClick Copy on the prompt
2 · OpenGo to the app shown in Run it in
3 · Fill inReplace the [ ] — type / to pick a file or person
4 · ReviewCopilot drafts; you check it before you share

Personalize Copilot once — every answer arrives the way you work

Four lines in Settings › Personalization › Customization, and every new chat answers in your format — no need to repeat it in each prompt.

Personalization Basic Premium

Tell Copilot once how you like your answers — it applies them to every new chat. Kept in your own mailbox, with the same security as your email.

Custom instructions · four lines for every employee
  1. 1
    Answer first Selalu mulai dengan jawaban dan kesimpulan, lalu berikan penjelasan singkat.
  2. 2
    Short & scannable Buat jawaban ringkas dan mudah dibaca: gunakan poin-poin, serta tabel untuk angka, tanggal, dan perbandingan.
  3. 3
    Sources, no guessing Cantumkan sumber (email, file, atau rapat) untuk setiap angka, dan sampaikan jika Anda tidak yakin — jangan menebak.
  4. 4
    Language & tone Jawab dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang profesional; biarkan istilah teknis seperti workover, lifting, dan HSSE dalam bahasa Inggris.
